description: Client-side script for the 'Account' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors such as setup, load, refresh, account type handling, toolbar buttons, merging accounts, and updating account numbers.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, adding fetches for parent account report and root types.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Handles form load event, setting query filters and initial display states.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form UI elements based on current document state, including toggling fields, read-only status, and toolbar buttons.

methods.name: account_type
methods.description: Adjusts display of tax rate and warehouse fields based on account type.

methods.name: add_toolbar_buttons
methods.description: Adds custom toolbar buttons for navigation and account conversion actions.

methods.name: merge_account
methods.description: Opens a dialog to merge the current account with an existing one.

methods.name: update_account_number
methods.description: Opens a dialog to update the account's name and number.
